tags.clue: She cooks dinner for the family.
He goes to work every day.
He is a boy. He plays soccer with a ball.
She is a girl. She likes drawing.
He does tai chi in the park.

blocks.title: 🔊 Meet the Family!
blocks.hint: Tap a card to hear it. Clap the syllables, then say it: whisper, normal, loud!

blocks.title: 💬 This Is My…
blocks.hint: Choose a person. Then grow your sentence, one step at a time.

blocks.title: 🚀 Say More About Your Family!
blocks.hint: Build a longer text: This is my… He/She is… He/She likes… Then say it!

rows.label: 2️⃣ What is he or she like?
3️⃣ What does he or she like?

blocks.title: ❓ Is This Your…?
blocks.hint: Look at the picture. Say your answer first, then tap Yes or No!
blocks.question: Is this your {en}?
blocks.yes: Yes, it is. This is my {en}.
blocks.no: No, it isn't. This is my {en}.

blocks.title: 🙈 Guess & Say
blocks.hint: What is hiding? Guess out loud first, then peek, then reveal!

blocks.title: 👂 Listen & Pop!
blocks.hint: Listen, then tap the person you heard.

blocks.title: 🧩 Build the Sentence
blocks.hint: Tap the words in order: This → is → my → family.

blocks.title: 📸 The Family Photo
blocks.hint: One asks, one answers. Then "Tell me more!" — and swap!

blocks.title: 🕵️ Clue Detective
blocks.hint: Read the clue. Who is it? Tap the person, then say "This is my…"

blocks.title: 🎁 Guess My Secret Person
blocks.hint: Ask "Is it your…?" out loud before every tap. Find the secret person!
blocks.guess: Is it your {en}? No, it isn't.
blocks.found: Yes, it is! This is my {en}.

blocks.title: 🎤 Talk Time
blocks.hint: Ask, then answer in a full sentence. Press Harder when it was easy!

levels.label: Level 1
lines: Do you have a brother or a sister?
Do you have a grandma or a grandpa?
Who is this in your family photo?
Do you live with your mom and dad?

levels.label: Level 2
lines: How old is your brother or sister?
What does your grandpa like doing?

levels.label: Level 3
lines: Who are you most like in your family? Why?
What do you do with your grandparents?
Tell me about a special day with your family.
If your family could travel anywhere, where would you go and why?

blocks.title: 🎉 Great job!
blocks.message: Great job! Now you can talk about your family!
